headline: Saudi Arabia Delivery App Orders Increase 25% to 129 Million in Q3
summary: Saudi Arabia's Transport General Authority reported delivery app orders exceeded 129 million in Q3, up 25.2% year-on-year. Growth was led by expansion in Riyadh and regional urban logistics demand.
why: Saudi Arabia's digital logistics growth aligns with economic diversification goals under Vision 2030.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Rapid growth in digital services supports retail logistics and e-commerce expansion.
